svg.title: Collatz Laboratory angle-path trails
svg.desc: 122 exact Collatz trajectories rendered using the Laboratory's reverse-orbit angle-path rule, with step length r/(1+r^1.2) and parity-dependent heading a*pi*(ln 2/ln 6 - (r mod 2)), for a=0.34. The softly intersecting threads are mathematical visualizations, not proof of the Collatz conjecture.
